**Scope**: `frontend/pages/`, `frontend/assets/`, `SkillBridge-KnowledgeBase/`  
**Evaluation Standard**: Nielsen Norman 10 Usability Heuristics, WCAG 2.1 AA, IEEE 830 SRS

## 2. UX/UI Heuristic & Usability Audit

### 2.1 Universal Auth Guard Market Lockout (Heuristic #3: User Control & Freedom)
- **Defect**: Navigating to `pages/projects.html` or `pages/project-detail.html` forcibly redirects unauthenticated users to `pages/auth/register.html`.
- **Impact**: Violates fundamental e-commerce / marketplace usability. Prospective students cannot browse projects before deciding whether to register. Returning registered users who are logged out are sent to registration instead of login, with no return redirect preserved.

### 2.2 Onboarding Profile Black Hole (Heuristic #6: Recognition Rather than Recall)
- **Defect**: Registration collects only `name`, `email`, and `password`. Academic information (university, major, semester), skills, and UMKM company details are never collected during onboarding.
- **Impact**: When a newly registered student opens a project detail page and clicks "AI Match", the engine compares an empty skills array against the project brief, immediately displaying a jarring **0% Match Score** with a red error card of missing skills.

### 2.3 Broken Lifecycle Continuity: Disconnected "My Projects" Views
- **Defect**: Both `student/my-projects.html` and `umkm/my-projects.html` display hardcoded static HTML cards rather than querying `SkillBridgeDB`.
- **Impact**: When a student submits an application or an UMKM publishes a project, the newly created item never appears on their dashboard. Users perceive that their submission has failed.

### 2.4 Role Trapping in Collaborative Workspace
- **Defect**: The only collaboration workspace exists at `pages/student/workspace.html`. When an UMKM partner accepts a student on `applicants.html`, they are redirected to `../student/workspace.html?id=p1`.
- **Impact**: The UMKM owner is presented with a `STUDENT MENU` sidebar (Home, Market, My Projects, Messages, Profile). Clicking any sidebar link triggers a permission denied toast (`Akses ditolak: Peran akun Anda tidak memiliki izin`) and forcefully ejects the owner back to `umkm/dashboard.html`.

### 2.5 Dead End: Orphaned Review System & Missing Handover Trigger
- **Defect**: `review.js` exists in the repository, but is never invoked anywhere in `workspace.html`. There is no "Selesaikan Proyek" button, no milestone verification button, and no trigger to open the review modal.
- **Impact**: Projects can never reach the `COMPLETED` state; mutual reviews cannot be submitted.

### 2.6 Linguistic Fragmentation (Chaotic "Indoglish")
- **Defect**: Uncontrolled mixture of English and Indonesian copy:
  - Landing page (`index.html`) is 95% English ("Bridge Your Skills", "Empowering Future Leaders"), but declares `<html lang="id">`.
  - Authentication (`login.html`) has English headers ("Welcome back", "Sign In") with Indonesian demo pickers ("14 Akun Siap Uji") and Indonesian error toasts.
  - Marketplace (`projects.html`) has English sidebar items above Indonesian settings ("Pengaturan & Tema") and a misspelled hybrid title ("Make your Portofolio Now!").
  - Project detail is 100% Indonesian ("Detail Proyek", "Keahlian yang Dibutuhkan").

## 3. Accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA) Audit

| Checkpoint | Scope | Defect Description | WCAG Criteria | Severity |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---:|
| **Non-Semantic Form Controls** | `workspace.html:177-195` | Task checkboxes are `<div class="task-check-circle" onclick="toggleTask(...)">` without `role="checkbox"`, `aria-checked`, `tabindex="0"`, or keyboard listeners. | 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value | **Major** |
| **Inaccessible Password Visibility Toggle** | `login.html:275-280` | Password eye icon is an inline SVG with `onclick`, lacking `role="button"`, `tabindex="0"`, and `aria-label`. | 2.1.1 Keyboard Navigation | **Major** |
| **Sub-44px Touch Targets** | `workspace.html`, `review.js:32-36` | Modal close buttons, task delete icons, and rating star buttons measure 15–24px. | 2.5.5 Target Size | **Medium** |
| **Missing Form Input Labels** | `projects.html`, dashboard topbars | Search inputs lack `<label>` elements and `aria-label` attributes. | 1.3.1 Info and Relationships | **Medium** |
| **Color Contrast Ratios** | `style.css` (Muted text `#94A3B8`) | Light gray text (`#94A3B8`) on white backgrounds (`#FFFFFF`) yields a 2.6:1 contrast ratio, failing the 4.5:1 minimum for normal text. | 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum) | **Major** |
